title: Land Ho!
summary: You and the player just sailed through the mist and arrived at the Misty Isles: glowing crystals, a market near the dock and an old lighthouse that is completely dark. You decided to explore together.

say.text: We made it! Look at this mist… and those crystals!

ask.goal: Tell Sam how you feel about the isles.
ask.context: You and the player just arrived by boat at the Misty Isles: thick mist, glowing crystals, a market and a dark lighthouse far away.
ask.hint: Wow, it's beautiful here! But I'm a little nervous.

title.text: Far away, the old lighthouse is dark…

say.text: That lighthouse is dark. Maybe that's why the mist never goes away.
There's a market over there. Someone must know something!

ask.context: You see a market near the dock and a dark lighthouse far away. You want to find out why the lighthouse is dark.
ask.hint: Let's go to the market and ask about the lighthouse.
